state.purpose: Mining trial M1: detect whether the current cloud/FinOps line is a local optimum by comparing materially different high-value economic events for the fixed goal of maximizing realized owner hourly earnings and reaching that state quickly.

publicEvidence.fact: Vertice states hundreds of procurement and finance leaders entrust more than $75B of spend to its platform and publishes customer cases including $330k savings in three months and 7x annual ROI.
publicEvidence.caveat: Vendor-reported customer and ROI evidence; does not prove a new entrant can reproduce the result.

publicEvidence.fact: IBM announced acquisition of FinOps/technology-business-management provider Apptio for $4.6B.
publicEvidence.caveat: Exit value of an established software platform, not evidence of our exact service.

publicEvidence.fact: PRGX describes modern AP recovery audits as rolling programs combining analytics, technology and audit expertise; separate official materials state contingent-fee recovery and average 10x ROI, and a published case reports $17M recovered.
publicEvidence.caveat: PRGX has decades of audit expertise, supplier workflows and enterprise trust that a new entrant lacks.

publicEvidence.fact: Chargeflow publicly prices automated chargeback recovery at 25% of recovered chargebacks with no payment until recovery and a 4x ROI guarantee.
publicEvidence.caveat: Chargeflow executes a fuller dispute workflow and has integrations; our first version intentionally does less.

publicEvidence.fact: Paddle Retain uses performance-based pricing for larger companies and flat-fee pricing starting at $500/month for smaller ones; Retain automatically recovers failed payments and tracks recovery against a baseline.
publicEvidence.caveat: Retain is integrated software that executes recovery; our first version leaves effects to the customer.

publicEvidence.fact: Paddle acquired ProfitWell for over $200M in cash and equity, including retention and pricing software.
publicEvidence.caveat: Acquisition of a mature subscription software business, not proof of this exact entrant.

publicEvidence.fact: Datasite acquired Grata and later Sourcescrub and Valu8 while committing substantial capital to private-market intelligence and sourcing capabilities.
publicEvidence.caveat: Strategic value is strongly tied to proprietary datasets and established deal workflows.

world.nullOption: If every candidate remains weak or evidence transfer is poor, preserve capital and continue mining rather than forcing a winner.

candidates.name: cloud-cost-action-receipt
candidates.claim: A cloud-using company provides recurring read-only billing exports. The factory returns a bounded set of evidence-backed cost-saving action tickets with exact resource/action/risk/expected annualized savings. Customer executes changes. A later billing export produces ticket-linked effect receipts. First paid audit can convert to periodic refreshes. No production write credentials and no generated infrastructure patches.

candidates.name: saas-renewal-savings-watch
candidates.claim: A finance/procurement team provides a renewal calendar plus current software contracts, quotes and usage facts. The factory returns standardized renewal actions such as renew, cancel, downgrade, consolidate, re-quote or investigate, with evidence and expected savings. Customer negotiates and executes. First paid renewal batch can convert to prepaid recurring renewal monitoring.

candidates.name: ap-leakage-recovery-watch
candidates.claim: A transaction-intensive company provides accounts-payable transaction exports plus available invoice/vendor/contract facts. The factory identifies duplicate payments, missed discounts, suspicious overpayments and recovery candidates, with evidence and exact transaction lineage. Customer validates and performs supplier recovery. First paid recovery audit can convert to recurring overpayment-prevention monitoring.

candidates.name: chargeback-evidence-factory
candidates.claim: A digital merchant provides chargeback, order, payment and customer-message exports. The factory builds prioritized dispute evidence packages with exact supporting records and expected recoverable value. Customer submits or approves each dispute. Recurring chargeback batches create continuous demand; the factory has no custody of funds and no autonomous submission in the first version.

candidates.name: subscription-revenue-recovery-watch
candidates.claim: A subscription business provides failed-payment, cancellation and subscription event exports. The factory identifies recoverable revenue, recommends standardized retry/dunning/reactivation actions and measures subsequent recovered revenue against a declared baseline. Customer executes all payment/customer-contact effects. One paid recovery snapshot can convert to recurring monitoring.

candidates.name: ma-intelligence-watch
candidates.claim: An M&A advisor provides an approved target universe plus acquisition mandate. The factory ranks and screens the universe and returns evidence-backed target memos on recurring capacity. It does not source from a proprietary database, contact targets, negotiate, perform DD, or act as intermediary/FA. Customer executes every deal effect.

trial.uncertainty: Are we missing a materially better economic event than the current cloud/FinOps line?
trial.method: One fresh blind Jev comparison across distinct economic mechanisms. Prior Noul values excluded.
trial.stopRule: After one pass, add exactly one reversed-order pass only if the frontier is materially ambiguous. No third Jev call for this uncertainty.

constraints: No full platform build before paid evidence.
First paid validation should be file/export based where possible.
Customer executes all external monetary, production, supplier, payment and deal effects.
Unsupported or ambiguous cases fail closed instead of defaulting to owner research.
Compare only within each concern; do not add unrelated themes into one global score.
